description: The thinking behind an AI answer, behind a disclosure: "Thinking…" has a light passing through it while the model works, the thinking opens on its own and closes into "Thought for 12s" when it ends, and it streams in as muted markdown.
moves: While it thinks, a soft light passes through "Thinking…"; it stops for reduced motion.
The thinking opens to its real height on its own when streaming starts, and closes when it ends unless the reader toggled it.
The thinking rises in as it opens.
Each new paragraph or list of the thinking rises in as it streams, and the newest line stays in view.
The chevron turns down on a spring.

propDocs.Reasoning.streaming: True while the model is still thinking: the trigger shimmers and the thinking shows.
propDocs.Reasoning.duration: How long it thought, in seconds. Without it, the time between `streaming` turning on and off is measured.
propDocs.Reasoning.autoClose: Close on its own when the thinking ends, unless the reader toggled it. Default true.
propDocs.Reasoning.defaultOpen: Open at first, when not streaming.
propDocs.Reasoning.open: Controlled open state. Streaming starting and ending still asks for a change through `onOpenChange`.
propDocs.ReasoningTrigger.thinkingLabel: The words while it thinks. Default "Thinking…".
propDocs.ReasoningTrigger.doneLabel: A function of the seconds that returns the words once it has finished. Default "Thought for 12s".
propDocs.ReasoningContent.children: The thinking as a markdown string (it streams with `streaming`), or your own content.

cssVars: Tallest the thinking gets before it scrolls
